In this powerful episode of iDream Social Spotlight with Kavitha, Lt. Gen. Arun Anantha Narayan (Retd.) shares his extraordinary journey of 42 years in the Indian Army, including surviving five bullet injuries and witnessing the harsh realities of life on the battlefield.

From choosing the Indian Army over IIT Madras to the emotional sacrifices soldiers make, this exclusive interview reveals the challenges, responsibilities and realities of military life that rarely reach the public.

In this interview:

Why he chose the Indian Army over IIT Madras

His experience of being wounded by bullets five times

The untold realities of life on the battlefield

The emotional cost of losing a young soldier

The challenges of military leadership and saving soldiers' lives

How drones and modern technology are changing warfare

Operation Sindoor and India's changing military strategies

India's defence technology, innovation and self-reliance

42 years of service, sacrifice and lessons from the Army

Watch this compelling conversation to understand the courage, commitment and sacrifices behind the uniform.
